en.bodyHtml:
Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten touches checkout, payment plugins, cache exclusions and sometimes cron for orders/emails.

Shop failures cost revenue; isolate checkout from blog plugins.

What this article covers

You carry out “Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten” via wp-admin, files and the hosting panel, with backup awareness and verification.

Unique checkpoints

This long-form guide is written for Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten (slug multisite-of-meerdere-shops-aandachtspunten).

Signals from title/topic: multisite, meerdere, shops, aandachtspunten. Stay in the matching layer — do not mix DNS edits with wp-admin fixes unless this topic explicitly requires it.

  • If there is an error: keep the exact text for “Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten” — paraphrasing slows support.
  • When unsure between panel A and B: pick the layer topic tz-ec-multisite-of-meerdere-shops-aandachtspunte-739b9 implies.
  • Confirm you are on the correct product/domain before applying “Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten”.

Scope

Internal classification: topic tz-ec-multisite-of-meerdere-shops-aandachtspunte-739b9 — include that context in tickets about “Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten”.

What you need

  • Recent Installatron or panel backup (files + database).
  • Access to /wp-admin of the correct site.
  • DirectAdmin login for File Manager/PHP/SSL if wp-admin fails.
  • Ability to place a test order or use staging.

How to execute

  1. Create a backup; note active payment and shipping plugins for “Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten”.
  2. Test checkout in a private window; note the exact error or hang point.
  3. Exclude cart/checkout/my-account from full-page cache.
  4. Check WooCommerce → Status for errors, webhooks and scheduled actions.
  5. Disable the last changed checkout plugin to isolate conflicts.
  6. Repeat the core check for “Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten” from a second network or private window.

Verify

  • Test order completes.
  • Confirmation email arrives.
  • Article check multisite-of-meerdere-shops-aandachtspunten: “Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten” yields the expected result without regressing web/mail/DNS.

Pitfalls

  • Testing a live payment gateway without sandbox.

Escalation

  • You are stuck after the steps for “Multisite or meerdere shops: aandachtspunten” and have error text + timestamp.
  • There is production impact (checkout, mail, DNS) outside business hours.
  • You suspect account compromise or malware.

Practical tip

Tip: Keep WooCommerce, PHP and payment plugins on supported combinations.

Note: Caching checkout can cause duplicate orders or empty carts.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
